title: Evaluation of scalar extension from a constant ring presheaf
statement: Let C be a small category and k a ring in universe u. Let R:C opposite -> RingCat be a presheaf of possibly noncommutative rings, and phi:const(k) -> Id.op followed by R a morphism of ring presheaves. Suppose presheaf scalar restriction along phi is a right adjoint. For every object U of C opposite and module carrier universe Type(max u v), presheaf pullback along phi followed by evaluation on U is naturally isomorphic to evaluation on U followed by the balanced ordinary scalar extension [def-pod-ring-scalar-extension] along phi_U. No field, sheafification, commutativity or centrality hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 006R, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict-presheaves. Canonical tag page read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/006R. Presheaf-only, noncommutative and larger-universe formulation of the sectionwise adjunction.

proof.text: Use the ordinary scalar-extension adjunction of [def-pod-ring-scalar-extension] at every object U. Define E(M)(U)=ModuleCat.ringExtendScalars(phi_U)(M(U)). Define restriction by transposing M(U) -> M(V) followed by the scalar-extension unit at V; naturality of phi gives the required k-linearity. The adjunction implies restriction(eta_U(m))=eta_V(res(m)). Equality of maps out of E(M)(U) can be tested on eta_U, because the Hom equivalence is injective. This verifies identity and composition. Extend component maps by ringExtendScalars.map; unit naturality verifies their compatibility with restriction, and functoriality gives a functor E. These are fully proved private definitions and helpers in the delivered module.

proof.text: Build a natural Hom equivalence (E(M) -> N) equivalent to (M -> pushforward(phi)(N)) by applying the ordinary scalar-extension adjunction at each object. The forward map sends m to f_U(eta_U(m)). The inverse is the component transpose; its value on eta_U(m) is h_U(m). The proved restriction-unit formula verifies presheaf naturality in both directions. The component Hom equivalences give inverse laws and naturality in both M and N, yielding an actual adjunction E left-adjoint to pushforward(phi).

source.place: Tag 006R, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict-presheaves. Canonical tag page read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/006R. Presheaf-only, noncommutative and larger-universe formulation of the sectionwise adjunction.

proof.text: PresheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction and the constructed adjunction have the same right adjoint. Apply Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and Functor.isoWhiskerRight with evaluation at U. By construction E followed by evaluation is definitionally evaluation followed by ordinary ringExtendScalars(phi_U), so the inverse evaluated comparison is exactly the asserted natural isomorphism. The proof uses no nonzero modules, no nonempty site, and no commutativity; all carriers have the required Type(max u v) universe.

theorem nonempty_pullbackEvaluationIso
    [(PresheafOfModules.pushforward.{max u v} φ).IsRightAdjoint] (U : Cᵒᵖ) :
    Nonempty (PresheafOfModules.pullback.{max u v} φ ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.evaluation R U ≅
      PresheafOfModules.evaluation ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of k)) U ⋙
        ModuleCat.ringExtendScalars.{u, v} (φ.app U).hom)
